functions.name: GetIsNoGood
functions.signature: GetIsNoGood(In Level Sequence, Out No Good)
functions.docs:
Gets whether the user has marked this shot as no good.
@return Whether the value was set by the user.

functions.name: GetIsFlagged
functions.signature: GetIsFlagged(In Level Sequence, Out Is Flagged)

Gets whether this was flagged by a user.
@return Whether the value was set by the user.

functions.name: GetIsRecorded
functions.signature: GetIsRecorded(In Level Sequence, Out Is Recorded)
functions.docs:
Gets whether this was recorded.
@return Whether the value was set.

functions.name: GetIsSubSequence
functions.signature: GetIsSubSequence(In Level Sequence, Out Is Sub Sequence)
functions.docs:
Gets whether this was recorded as a subsequence.
@return Whether the value was set.

functions.name: GetFavoriteRating
functions.signature: GetFavoriteRating(In Level Sequence, Out Favorite Rating)
functions.docs:
Gets the favorite rating. The favorite rating is like a star rating, usually 1-3 if it was rated.
@return Whether the value was set by the user.
